meta.title: [alpha_factory] add memory limit to MemoryAgent
meta.body_summary: Add a memory record cap using AGI_INSIGHT_MEMORY_LIMIT environment variable, trimming history when exceeded, with test for cap behavior.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added memory cap; PR merged instantly without review despite failing tests listed in body; no performance evidence or maintainer discussion.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 85 changed lines, this is a small edit. It adds a memory cap and trims history, a targeted resource-limit fix that fits a small-step performance PR. The merge occurred without any review, consistent with low-friction self-merging in this repository.

core_change_summary.description: In memory_agent.py, added a check for AGI_INSIGHT_MEMORY_LIMIT environment variable; if set, and if the number of stored records exceeds the limit, it trims the history list to that cap before saving. Added test file for cap behavior.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file adds coverage for the memory cap and env var handling.
